title: Midea RSS26 — Mandatory diagnostic mode entry
description: Enter mandatory mode for forced compressor (1) or ice maker cycle (3) per §10.5.

steps.title: Enter mandatory mode
steps.body: Press LOCK/UNLOCK + FRZ.TEMP together 3 s to enter/exit. Lock settings after selection. Display 0=normal; 1=compressor forced 36 hr; 3=ice maker turn-over ×2 then fill. Power-cycle after use.
